verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents bank and credit card reconciliation against the bank statement, and its AI Close agents reconcile accounts and surface discrepancies for review. That covers the core reconcile-and-review flow, but the evidence never describes matched, unmatched, or duplicate transaction views. missing for 10: explicit matched/unmatched transaction surfacing, duplicate-transaction detection, per-account reconciliation workflow details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can reconcile each bank account against the ledger with matched, unmatched, and duplicate transactions surfaced for review

citations.quote: performing a reconciliation is the best way to ensure every single transaction is accounted for and matches your bank statement exactly
AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
